registration.HYPOTHESIS: Conditional on the last 1 and 5 one-minute returns and the trailing 30-bar realised volatility, the 15-minute forward log return of SPY during the regular session has a distribution that a volatility-scaled Gaussian with a fitted conditional mean predicts with higher out-of-sample log likelihood than the same Gaussian with zero mean.
registration.MECHANISM_PLAUSIBLE: Short-horizon serial dependence in index returns is weak and widely known; where it exists it is small relative to the spread. The plausible reason it is not fully priced is that it is not worth anyone's spread to price it -- which is also why it may not be worth ours. That is the point of the economic stage.
registration.CUTOFF_CONVENTION: bar CLOSE at time t; the forecast may use bars with event_time <= t

M0.sigma: rv_30 * k, k fit on TRAIN as mean(|y|)/mean(rv_30)

M1.mean: a + b1*ret_1 + b5*ret_5, OLS on TRAIN

registration.OVERLAP: adjacent targets share 14 of 15 increments; dependence-aware statistic
registration.NULL_CONTROL: N0_BLOCK_PERMUTATION: outcomes permuted across 20-bar blocks; state kept
registration.PRIMARY_METRIC: out-of-sample log likelihood differential, M1 minus M0
registration.STOP: 1.0 * rv_30 below/above entry; certified 1R = stop distance + full round-trip spread
registration.ECONOMIC_TEST: On EVALUATION only, after the statistical stage: mean after-cost return of the selected expression, with a dependence-aware standard error, versus CASH = 0.
registration.MARKET_BENCHMARK: Executable price range = last close +/- modelled half-spread. Option-implied distribution at 15 minutes: NOT_ESTIMABLE from the sources on box; not claimed.
registration.FAIL_STATISTICAL: DM-HAC z <= 2.0 on VALIDATION -> NO_SIGNAL. Evaluation is not opened.
registration.FAIL_ECONOMIC: mean after-cost return of the best non-cash expression <= 0 -> NO_OPPORTUNITY
registration.PASS: z > 2.0 on validation AND z > 2.0 on evaluation AND after-cost mean > 0 with z_econ > 2.0 on evaluation. Even then: 'historically evaluated', not 'validated'.
registration.NULL_MUST: N0 must produce NO_SIGNAL. If it does not, the harness is broken and nothing counts.
